mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.product_id, f.create_time, p.title, p.price, p.images, p.status, p.condition, u.id as seller_id, u.real_name as seller_name, u.avatar as seller_avatar FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
